scripts.text: Wait, don't come any closer. I can't stand your smell, it makes me feel dizzy.
scripts.translation: 等等，別再靠近了。我受不了你的氣味，聞著就頭暈。

scripts.text: OdesKoUor Ko NuffSharUden Ko CyaVenah An NudNuffser An KoRivehAdor Mu LarseorAnu O DorNe
scripts.translation: OdesKoUor Ko NuffSharUden Ko CyaVenah An NudNuffser An KoRivehAdor Mu LarseorAnu O DorNe

scripts.text: You don't look sophisticated, but I think you are better than those uncivilized guys who are around the snowfield.
scripts.translation: 你看起來不怎麼優雅，不過比雪原上那群野蠻的傢伙好多了。

scripts.text: AlahCyamah U MeKoser Ir TimaurRiveh Di LarsRasTi Di AgolKones Or AlahUdenAndu Ee FusRe
scripts.translation: AlahCyamah U MeKoser Ir TimaurRiveh Di LarsRasTi Di AgolKones Or AlahUdenAndu Ee FusRe

scripts.text: No offense, I was not looking at you with sympathy.
scripts.translation: 別誤會，我並不是在同情你。

scripts.text: I just wondered how you could walk with that heavy body...
scripts.translation: 我只是好奇，你那麼重的身體是怎麼走路的...

scripts.text: AnuFuloUor Ko CyaWosnes Ha WosAnuAsh O WosDuAno O
scripts.translation: AnuFuloUor Ko CyaWosnes Ha WosAnuAsh O WosDuAno O

scripts.text: FuloAndueo Ie WosGothLars Ee Tinarmaur Or AlahnahVa Or narAnuFulo So KoCya
scripts.translation: FuloAndueo Ie WosGothLars Ee Tinarmaur Or AlahnahVa Or narAnuFulo So KoCya

scripts.text: It is shame that I have to
I am just too delicate to fight with them.
scripts.translation: 我太嬌弱了，沒法和它們戰鬥。

scripts.text: You are better than those fat Saphas, but still you are not a beautiful thing also.
scripts.translation: 雖然比那些肥胖的薩法強，但也談不上漂亮。

scripts.text: How did you find this wonderful place?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼找到這個好地方的？
這裡真是個優雅的地方。

scripts.text: I don't think you can be here with us.
scripts.translation: 我不覺得你能和我們待在一起。

scripts.text: Don't even think about getting close to me!
This land was such a waste land.
scripts.translation: 這片土地曾經一片荒蕪。
沒有任何生物能在這裡生存。

scripts.text: but, once we inhabited this place, it has been changing day by day.
scripts.translation: 不過，自從我們住進這裡，一切便日新月異。

scripts.text: Now, all the problems are gone.
scripts.translation: 現在，所有問題都解決了。
除了那些又醜又胖的薩帕族。

scripts.text: How can we be rid of those things?
scripts.translation: 我們要怎麼才能擺脫那些傢伙？

scripts.text: Hey, you~! Human! How did you find us?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你~！人類！你是怎麼找到我們的？

scripts.text: What does your human world look like?
scripts.translation: 你們人類的世界是什麼樣的？

scripts.text: Is it fun to be there?
AnnarNor So marFarAno Di NudThusNei Ir Ir
scripts.translation: AnnarNor So marFarAno Di NudThusNei Ir Ir

scripts.text: WhaModKo Or eoNeiNor Di ImanDunah O O
scripts.translation: WhaModKo Or eoNeiNor Di ImanDunah O O

scripts.text: Don't talk to me. What do you want?
scripts.translation: 別跟我說話。你想幹什麼？

scripts.text: I know you will blame something on me right?
scripts.translation: 我知道，你又想把什麼事怪到我頭上，對吧？

scripts.text: I don't want to listen to other people...
scripts.translation: 我才不想聽別人說什麼...

scripts.text: I am perfect as I am!
You can be part of us!
I don't want to touch them at all.
But they are ruining my Yggdrasilberries.
scripts.translation: 但它們正在毀掉我的世界樹漿果。

scripts.text: But for our glory, I will fight!
scripts.translation: 但為了我們的榮耀，我會戰鬥！

scripts.text: They should feel honored to be battling with us!
scripts.translation: 能與我們交手，它們應該感到榮幸！

scripts.text: I am so bored. I have nothing to do.
Even my friends are fighting with those giants, but it is not really my job to help them.
scripts.translation: 朋友們還在和那些巨人打仗，不過幫他們又不是我的工作。

scripts.text: Or should I get more beauty sleep?
scripts.translation: 還是該多睡一會兒美容覺？

scripts.text: Flying in the sky is not easy.
scripts.translation: 在天空中飛翔並不容易。

scripts.text: But it is better than a walk on the ground.
scripts.translation: 但這比在地面上行走要好多了。

scripts.text: Are you a human? Poor thing...
You can't have these beautiful wings?
scripts.translation: 你沒有這麼美麗的翅膀嗎？

scripts.text: It is obvious that we are the only ones who are blessed.
scripts.translation: 顯而易見，只有我們才受到祝福。

scripts.text: Others are so dirty and messy!
This is Splendide, the garrison base of the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 這裡是輝煌領域，拉菲尼的駐軍基地。

scripts.text: SeAshLu Di YurDiebTing Ee VeModTur No NuffLarsVa No
scripts.translation: SeAshLu Di YurDiebTing Ee VeModTur No NuffLarsVa No

scripts.text: This is Splendide, the garrison base of the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 這裡是輝煌領域，拉菲尼的駐軍基地。

scripts.text: SeAshLu Di YurDiebTing Ee VeModTur No NuffLarsVa No
scripts.translation: SeAshLu Di YurDiebTing Ee VeModTur No NuffLarsVa No

scripts.text: See? Same as a streetlight, right?
scripts.translation: 看見了嗎？和路燈一樣，對吧？

scripts.text: This is the underground prison of Splendide.
scripts.translation: 這裡是斯普蘭迪德的地下監獄。

scripts.text: Those who are guilty and prisoners are detained here.
scripts.translation: 罪犯和囚犯都關押在這裡。

scripts.text: If you do something suspicious, you must be detained here too, so you'd better to be careful!
scripts.translation: 做出可疑舉動的話，你也會被關在這裡，最好小心點！

scripts.text: GothAnAsh er NohVaAgol Yee CyaOsaDor U Aman U
scripts.translation: GothAnAsh er NohVaAgol Yee CyaOsaDor U Aman U

scripts.text: TurOdesVrum Ir TalDathOsa Ie WosAgolVrum Ha neaNudHir Ha SeAnVil Di narAlahLars Yu
scripts.translation: TurOdesVrum Ir TalDathOsa Ie WosAgolVrum Ha neaNudHir Ha SeAnVil Di narAlahLars Yu

scripts.text: If you make too much noise, the prisoners will cause trouble. So try to keep quiet at all times.
scripts.translation: 如果你弄出太大動靜，囚犯們就會鬧事。所以儘量保持安靜。

scripts.text: AnduVeldRe Ko VeldReFulo So LomaurDu So	So
scripts.translation: AnduVeldRe Ko VeldReFulo So LomaurDu So	So
給我打針！求求你！救救我！

scripts.text: How can I communicate secretly with Manuk!!
scripts.translation: 我怎麼才能秘密地和曼努克聯絡！！

scripts.text: Hi~~ do you hear the beautiful music coming from afar~?
scripts.translation: 嗨~~ 你聽到從遠處傳來的美妙音樂了嗎~？

scripts.text: I am just a poet enjoying the ambience...
scripts.translation: 只是個陶醉於此地氛圍的詩人罷了...

scripts.text: I cam here the other day, requesting to take notes of this new world and they allow me to follow the adventurers here.
scripts.translation: 前幾天，我申請來記錄這個新世界，獲准跟隨冒險者來到這裡。

scripts.text: I became familiar with the Lapine.
scripts.translation: 我漸漸和拉菲尼熟悉起來了。

scripts.text: It was quite awkward at first... Since I didn't knew their language.
scripts.translation: 起初，因為不懂他們的語言，相處有些尷尬...

scripts.text: But, one I started to play my instruments... they loved it.
scripts.translation: 可我一奏起樂器，他們就喜歡上了。

scripts.text: They're fairies that know how to enjoy their lives..
scripts.translation: 她們是懂得享受生活的妖精..

scripts.text: They are quite curious... I am honored to have met them...
scripts.translation: 她們真是好奇...能遇見她們，我深感榮幸...

scripts.text: So do you want to listen to my playing?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你想聽聽我的演奏嗎？

scripts.text: You must have a keen ear.
This is a great piece but I wouldn't recommend it while dining...
scripts.translation: 這是一首很棒的曲子，但不建議用餐時聽...

scripts.text: This song tells of a legendary Assassin Cross that lived in the desert.
scripts.translation: 這首歌講述了一位生活在沙漠中的傳奇十字刺客。

scripts.text: This song has quite an interesting story~

that would shine as if made of gold.

scripts.text: Why would you stare at me like that if you didn't want to listen to my playing
scripts.translation: 不想聽我演奏，怎麼還這樣盯著我？

scripts.text: You look like someone I know.

scripts.translation: 是，我的長相是挺普通的...

scripts.text: But I doubt we've ever met before.
scripts.translation: 不過，我們應該沒見過吧。

scripts.text: - Nell seems embarrassed, then starts playing very complicated music -
scripts.translation: - 內爾似乎有些尷尬，然後開始演奏非常複雜的樂曲 -

scripts.text: The poet on the stage is mysterious.
He arrived and started playing music.
scripts.translation: 他就來了，開始演奏音樂。

scripts.text: This is music from your country yes?
scripts.translation: 這是來自你國家的音樂嗎？

scripts.text: - He is nodding his head to the sound of the music -
Do you know how to play a similar sound?
scripts.translation: 你也會演奏這樣的音樂嗎？

scripts.text: - He is nodding his head to the sound of the music -
I got bored eating home cooked food.
The only thing that keeps me coming here is fruit soup...
scripts.translation: 只有這裡的水果湯，還能讓我想來...

scripts.text: Why are you staring at me eating dinner?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼盯著我吃晚飯？

scripts.text: - He is giving me a odd stare as he eats his dinner -
scripts.translation: - 他一邊吃晚餐一邊用奇怪的眼神盯著我 -

scripts.text: We are quite impressed by the poet.
scripts.translation: 我們對那位詩人印象深刻。

scripts.text: We Laphine love music as well.
scripts.translation: 我們拉菲涅也很喜歡音樂。

scripts.text: I never imagined that I would ever hear such exotic music.
scripts.translation: 我從沒想過自己能聽到如此異國風情的音樂。

scripts.text: I want to study music someday.
scripts.translation: 我希望有一天能學習音樂。

scripts.text: I plan to write much about the study of instruments and music
scripts.translation: 我打算寫很多關於樂器和音樂研究的內容

scripts.text: Someday you should listen to mu people's music.
scripts.translation: 有機會，你也該聽聽我們族人的音樂。

scripts.text: - He seems frustrated that you don't understand him -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎很沮喪，因為你聽不懂他的話 -

scripts.text: - He is almost sleeping but he is still managing to hold a cup with a drink in it. He must be really tired-
scripts.translation: - 他幾乎睡著了，但手裡還緊緊握著一杯飲料。他一定累壞了 -

scripts.text: You are a stranger here, aren't you?
I am watching him to prevent anything bad from happening.
scripts.translation: 我正盯著他，免得出什麼事。

scripts.text: The upper side people allow you to pass here...
scripts.translation: 上面的那些人允許你從這裡通過...

scripts.text: But nobody knows what's going to happen in this battlefield.
scripts.translation: 不過，誰也不知道這片戰場上會發生什麼。

scripts.text: Anyway, what's that instrument over there?
scripts.translation: 總之，那邊那個樂器是什麼？

scripts.text: -The Laphine Soldier wants to tell you something, but just stops talking as you give him a blank stare -
scripts.translation: - 拉菲尼士兵想告訴你些什麼，但當你一臉茫然地看著他時，他就閉嘴了 -

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but we don't sell food to strangers.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我們不向陌生人出售食物。

scripts.text: You guys also need to be careful of food here.
scripts.translation: 你們也得注意這裡的食物。

scripts.text: You're going to have to find food somewhere else.
scripts.translation: 你們得去別的地方找食物了。

scripts.text: - You just grin and smile. It's frustrating not to be able to understand their language. -
scripts.translation: - 你只是咧嘴一笑。聽不懂他們的語言真讓人沮喪。 -

scripts.text: his camp serves a military purpose. But we also have a need for bars.
scripts.translation: 這裡雖然是軍事營地，但我們也需要酒吧。

scripts.text: How else can a soldier release stress if not through drinking...
scripts.translation: 士兵如果不喝酒，還能怎麼釋放壓力呢...

scripts.text: We are here to support the laphine soldier by giving good drinks and entertainment.
scripts.translation: 我們提供美酒和娛樂，為拉菲尼士兵服務。

scripts.text: This is inspired by stars, and we tested it by cutting the thread floating over the water.
scripts.translation: 設計靈感來自星辰，我們用它切斷浮在水面上的絲線，試了試鋒利程度。

scripts.text: Hmm, we rarely used swords. But it looks great as a decoration.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我們很少用劍。但作為裝飾品看起來很不錯。

scripts.text: - Seems their busy talking about weapons -
ModNorNor U DimVohlWeh O DimAmannea An WosAnoNoh An AnduMeOdes So TalAdor.
scripts.translation: ModNorNor U DimVohlWeh O DimAmannea An WosAnoNoh An AnduMeOdes So TalAdor.

scripts.text: DurNohHir Ha UorVaThus Di AshNuffLon U mahNuffThus U RuAmanAgol Ir NohHir...?
scripts.translation: DurNohHir Ha UorVaThus Di AshNuffLon U mahNuffThus U RuAmanAgol Ir NohHir...?

scripts.text: Have you come here to see the Laphine's military storage?
scripts.translation: 你是來參觀拉菲涅的軍需倉庫的嗎？

scripts.text: Nevermind. These are useless to them...
scripts.translation: 算了，這些東西對他們沒用...

scripts.text: How can this delicate sword be used by those brutes...?
scripts.translation: 那些粗人，怎麼用得了這麼精巧的劍...？

scripts.text: ModNorNor U DimVohlWeh O DimAmannea An WosAnoNoh An AnduMeOdes So TalAdor.
scripts.translation: ModNorNor U DimVohlWeh O DimAmannea An WosAnoNoh An AnduMeOdes So TalAdor.

scripts.text: DurNohHir Ha UorVaThus Di AshNuffLon U mahNuffThus U RuAmanAgol Ir NohHir...?
scripts.translation: DurNohHir Ha UorVaThus Di AshNuffLon U mahNuffThus U RuAmanAgol Ir NohHir...?

scripts.text: Have you ever gone to the East side?
Oh me! You know beauty when you see it don't you~?!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！你倒是很懂得欣賞美嘛~！
